evidence.title: fix(skills): re-apply a Skill's side effects when a session is resumed by TianYuan1024 · Pull Request #11280 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(skills): re-apply a Skill's side effects when a session is resumed
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: resumed sessions re-apply each Skill's allowedTools rules and hooks, closing a fail-open bug.
description: A merged pull request (#11280) in QwenLM/qwen-code: resuming a session with --continue or --resume re-applies the side effects of every Skill the model loaded — its allowedTools session allow rules and its hooks — but only when the recorded response still matches SKILL.md on disk and the Skill is enabled, model-visible, activated and trusted. Session allow rules are also cleared when the process switches sessions, so a Skill's grants no longer outlive the session that loaded it. Fixes #11180.
